text:
Fixed `TLRUCache` re-assignment expiration handling.

Root cause: replacing a key created a new expiry entry but left the old heap entry active, so the old deadline could evict the newly assigned value.

Change: mark the previous heap item as removed after a successful replacement, allowing the new value to remain valid until its refreshed deadline. All targeted tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed `TLRUCache` re-assignment expiration handling.

Root cause: replacing a key created a new expiry entry but left the old heap entry active, so the old deadline could evict the newly assigned value.

Change: mark the previous heap item as removed after a successful replacement, allowing the new value to remain valid until its refreshed deadline. All targeted tests pass.
